answer_1.quote: We evaluate our generation and planning models on datasets from three distinct domains for multiparagraph-level text generation: (1) argument generation (ARGGEN) ... (2) writing opinionated articles (OPINION) ... (3) composing news reports (NEWS) ... human judges also rate our system outputs as more relevant and coherent.
answer_1.outputs: Multi-sentence generated texts (drafts and refined versions) for arguments, opinion articles, and news reports

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation with BLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR shows that, by informing the generation model with sentence-level content plans, our model significantly outperforms a BART model fine-tuned with the same set of keyphrases as input.

answer_4.quote: We hire four proficient English speakers to rate three aspects of the generated arguments on a scale of 1 (worst) to 5 (best): fluency, coherence, and relevance.
answer_4.guideline: Rate fluency, coherence, and relevance on a 1-5 Likert scale for each generated text.
